purpose: Freeze response-independent measurement routes for the three biological predictor families before any generalized trait/interactions turnover outcome is opened.

context_heterogeneity.primary_definition: Median pairwise Euclidean distance in a predeclared standardized CHELSA climate space, calculated on response-independent occupied locations; trait systems use equal-species aggregation and interaction systems use network-site aggregation.

source_stack.role: partner identity/weight source independent of primary trait data and independent of Mangal after source exclusion

ecological_specialization.primary_definition: 1 - normalized Shannon entropy of the focal taxon's partner distribution within the frozen interaction class; higher values mean more specialized.

independence_rule.trait_response: GloBI partner records are allowed because trait outcomes come from independent trait datasets.
independence_rule.mangal_interaction_response: All GloBI records traceable to the same Mangal dataset, source DOI, or source namespace as the response system must be excluded before specialization is computed.

dispersal_mobility.primary_definition: Use a direct, source-native dispersal/mobility measurement or validated taxon-group-specific proxy pinned before outcomes; do not manufacture one universal cross-taxon index.

forbidden_rescue: do not substitute vegetative plant height after seeing turnover outcomes
do not substitute seed mass after seeing turnover outcomes
do not create an outcome-optimized PC of correlated plant traits

future_transport_examples.source: AVONET or another pinned direct morphology/mobility source

response_independence_rules.TT: Predictors may use occurrence/climate/interaction/mobility sources but never focal trait values used in trait-time response.
response_independence_rules.TS: Predictors may use occurrence/climate/interaction/mobility sources, but climate extraction must use an occurrence sample independent of the focal trait measurement coordinates when feasible; sensitivity may reuse geometry only, never focal trait values.
response_independence_rules.IT: Predictors must not use partner-profile rows that enter the interaction-time response.
response_independence_rules.IS: Predictors must not use the Mangal edges or network weights that enter rewiring response; same-source specialization is forbidden.

shared_predictor_requirement.context_heterogeneity: Must be available for both time and space effects within a system before H2 common-driver inference.
shared_predictor_requirement.ecological_specialization: Must be available independently for both time and space effects within a system before H3 decoupling inference.
shared_predictor_requirement.dispersal_mobility: May be NOT_EVALUABLE without invalidating H1/H2/H3; it is secondary and cannot be replaced post-outcome.
